description: Implementation plan for the decisions in the map 'Wayfinder: roadmap to a defk verdict' (defk-dtw). The map holds the decisions; this epic sequences the build to docs/verdict.md. Its children are the verdict-specific tickets; the build tickets it orders live in the README Roadmap and the catalog epic (defk-9p6). Plan and phases are in the comment below.

comments.text:
Implementation plan (labels: ready-for-agent = AFK, ready-for-human = HITL).

Phase 1, start now, all parallel, all AFK:
- Safety and semantics: alloc/2 size overflow crashes the VM (defk-gtv), Build kernels with -ffp-contract=off (defk-jlk), Raise on non-finite floats like Elixir (defk-i00), Give arrays value semantics (defk-auo), Runtime threat list (defk-5fc)
- Oracle: Build Elixir mode (defk-v5d)
- Devex: Adopt the kernel compile error format (defk-vku)
- Language: Support bitwise operators (defk-w38), [i16]/[i32]/[f32] element types (defk-4ai), the bitstring accumulator (defk-cmr), Module attributes as constants (defk-ivt), Multi-clause kernels (defk-u9c)
- Catalog and evidence: Extend Defk.Bench.report/1 (defk-9p6.10), Record a mix release build (defk-ds0), Measure hardening flags (defk-j5n)
- Verdict: Draft docs/verdict.md with the pre-registered go/no-go rule (defk-sgw.2) -- do this before any workload row exists.
Conflict risk: v5d, vku, w38, 4ai, cmr, ivt, u9c, auo, i00 all edit lib/defk/compiler.ex. Run at most 2-3 of those at once, one worktree each, and rebase between landings; v5d first among them, since every later feature also needs an Elixir-mode meaning.

Phase 2, as blockers close (AFK):
- Differential agreement checks (defk-63k) after defk-v5d + defk-jlk; it blocks all six workloads
- Add u64, masked arithmetic and Defk.Bits (defk-wlu) after defk-w38
- Signed segments (defk-dki) and the accumulator through helpers (defk-ooq) after defk-cmr
- Actionable no-compiler error (defk-lb8) and Write docs/language.md (defk-sgw.1) after defk-vku
- Check docs/language.md examples in both modes (defk-rhb) after defk-63k + defk-sgw.1

Phase 3, the six target workloads (AFK, parallel; each optimises its own Elixir baseline):
Levenshtein (defk-9p6.11) -> masking (9p6.12) -> cosine (9p6.13) -> PCM (9p6.14) -> HLL (9p6.15) -> Gorilla (9p6.16), in readiness order; supporting baselines (9p6.6-9p6.9) any time.
Then Devex cold test (defk-sgw.3, AFK, once the subset is complete and documented).

Phase 4, HITL: Freeze the workload-results snapshot on a quiet machine (defk-sgw.4); then Write the verdict (defk-sgw.5, AFK draft); then Final verdict session (defk-sgw.6) closes the map.

Off the critical path: needs-triage defk-gqk, defk-6ag, defk-9qv, defk-nii; ready-for-human defk-klw, defk-yzw, defk-wnu (quiet machine), defk-o1w (exploration); the rest are P3/P4 agent tickets.
